label: Real run on this Mac's Docker Compose stack, with synthetic traffic from klaxon.traffic and one fault from klaxon.faults injected on purpose (synthetic data, a simulated provider, no real money). It records what the fault looks like from the outside; it is not the Klaxon agent.

fault.name: duplicate-delivery
fault.title: Payments counted twice in the books
fault.cause: a deploy of the ledger consumer without its dedupe (LEDGER_HANDLER=naive): every webhook the provider sends again, after an acknowledgement it never got, is booked a second time
expected_symptoms: the money check fails: events counted twice, the books ahead of the provider by their amounts
the webhook dashboard stays green, and consumer lag stays at 0
the ledger stops reporting 'already processed' while the confirmer still sees the same duplicates
fault.remedy: roll the ledger consumer back to the idempotent handler, then repair each double posting with a reversal (a write, so it needs approval)
